north_star: Verified business value that reduces distance to cash without weakening safety or trust.

revenue_distance.D1: contract, invoice, or paid order ready
revenue_distance.D2: qualified proposal, demo, or commercial trial requested
revenue_distance.D3: qualified meeting or buying conversation created
revenue_distance.D4: named prospect and outreach-ready proof/offer prepared
revenue_distance.D5: verified internal capability packaged into a customer-facing proof or offer
revenue_distance.D6: research, internal tooling, or cultural work with no verified commercial bridge yet

rules: Never count activity volume as revenue impact without evidence.
Never count faith or ritual participation as revenue by itself.
Translate faith into operational behaviors: truthful claims, promise keeping, peer support, recovery, learning, and customer trust.
Security work creates commercial value only when it reduces verified risk, increases reliability, or becomes defensible customer proof.
Research creates commercial value only when it improves a measurable capability or becomes reusable product evidence.
Every daily cycle must identify one action that moves at least one asset one revenue-distance step closer to D0.
Owner attention is scarce: operational detail stays internal unless a BOSS-final exception or material business outcome exists.
default_daily_actions: Package the strongest newly verified capability into one customer-facing proof, demo claim, or offer component.
Close or reassign the highest-value unresolved blocker before creating new work.
Convert one Senju/security/research result into a measurable business benefit statement with evidence.
Record one lesson that reduces repeated labor, false claims, or cycle time tomorrow.
